market.summary: India rose for another day while Wall Street fell. Nifty gained 0.38% to 25,387 and Sensex 0.52% to 82,532, led by PSU banks and realty; IT fell 0.9%. Monday's US tech sell-off (Nasdaq -2.5%) has not reached Indian hotel, media or broking stocks so far. Record foreign buying this month and steady crude are the support behind your trades.

points.text: Nifty +96 points (+0.38%) to 25,387.40; Sensex +427 points to 82,532.19; Nifty Smallcap -0.22%, and decliners slightly outnumbered advancers (2,148 vs 2,012).
Nasdaq -2.49% and S&P 500 -1.92% on Monday, on worries about AI valuations and US curbs on China's AI chip access.
Foreign investors have put a record $9.53 billion into Indian shares so far in November.
Brent Jan-27 futures at about $92.8 a barrel at 15:35 IST; PSU Bank index +1.95%, IT -0.90%.

market.watch: Whether the US tech sell-off spreads to Indian midcaps; the Nasdaq trend and FII flow figures.

GROWW.summary: Early investor Ribbit Capital sold 8.7 crore shares (1.4% of the company) in a ₹1,905 Cr block at ₹219, 2.6% under Monday's close. BlackRock, Fidelity, Kotak MF, NPS Trust, Norges Bank and others took it all, and the stock still closed higher at ₹227.53. A large supply overhang was absorbed by long-term funds without damaging the price, which supports the drift. You are +2.2R with the stop at cost.

points.text: Ribbit Capital entities sold 8.7 crore shares at ₹219 (₹1,905.3 Cr) in a block deal on 17 Nov.
The block was 1.4% of Groww's equity, priced 2.63% below Monday's close of ₹224.92.

NSE block-deal data lists buyers at ₹219, including Kotak Mahindra MF (about 2.05 crore shares across four trades), BlackRock funds (about 1.26 crore), Fidelity funds (about 0.78 crore), HDFC Life (26 lakh), NPS Trust (23 lakh) and Norges Bank (11.5 lakh).
US broker Robinhood fell 7.5% on Monday, but Groww closed up 1.2% at ₹227.53 on 1.7x volume.

GROWW.watch: ₹219 (block price) is now a support reference; the plan sells half on a close below the 10 EMA (₹219).
